usage: 雲端 (cloud) as a noun usually refers to internet-based storage or computing services.
It is often used to describe digital files or data saved on remote servers instead of on a local device.
雲端 can be used metaphorically in technology-related discussions when talking about online accessibility.
The word often appears in compound nouns or phrases like 雲端儲存 (cloud storage) or 雲端服務 (cloud service).
